title_or_table: Biographical Directory of Article III Federal Judges, 1789 to present, export file federal-judicial-service.csv (active judges only)
observation_period: Judges in active service on the export's latest record (latest commission date 2026-10-22); years counted to November 11, 2026
universe_or_base: Judges in active service, each counted once by FJC ID: 845 judges from the export's 850 service records of Article III judges with no senior-status or termination date
unit: judges in active service in each two-year bin of years as a federal judge; bin_start and bin_end in years
vintage: FJC export as posted on November 11, 2026; the file states no as-of date
qualification: A judge who takes senior status still hears cases but leaves this count; vacancies are not in the file. Years in seat start at the commission for the current court, so a judge promoted from a district court counts from the promotion; years as a federal judge start at the first Article III commission

bin_start.description: lower edge of the bin, in the bin

bin_end.description: upper edge of the bin, not in the bin

judges.description: judges whose years as a federal judge fall in the bin

printed_source_line: Source: Federal Judicial Center, Biographical Directory of Article III Federal Judges, judges in active service, as of November 11, 2026, United States. Retrieved November 11, 2026. Judges on senior status are not counted; years as a federal judge computed from first commission dates and grouped in two-year bins by Oath & Action.
derivation: Each judge in active service counted once by FJC ID (nid) in the two-year bin, closed on the left, that holds the years since the first Article III commission, from 0 to 44 years (the data lead's corrected ruling (g), round 2)
notes: 845 judges in all, from 850 service records; median 8.02 years as a federal judge (Python statistics.median of the unrounded years)
Judges with more than one service record, in shared judgeships across districts (FJC IDs): 13762033, 1393956, 4444651, 8307871
Bin edges checked against inauguration dates: January 20 of 2001, 2009, 2017, 2021 and 2025 sit 25.81, 17.81, 9.81, 5.81 and 1.81 years before November 11, 2026, so no edge falls on one (H09)
